policy.centering: Full visible silhouette bounding-box center; alpha threshold32; maximum 1px deviation at both 1024 and256. Alpha-weighted centroid tracked separately for optical review.
policy.body: Scout chin-to-sole landmark119px at256; Farmer122px. Uniform scale only; hats/hair excluded from anatomy measurement.
policy.food: Main-body landmark widths matched to140px at256; spoon and leaves excluded.
